P1.4.text: Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production. Our experience is unparalleled. Key managers have not only accumulated decades of knowledge in the industry but have also worked together as a team for an average of 25 years. P1.7.text: Cactus™ SafeDrill ® Wellhead Systems include a complete line of drill-through single piece multi-bowl wellhead systems that enhance field personnel safety and save valuable rig time. These efficient and innovative systems, with a straight bore design and lock ring technology, are safer, easier and faster to install than conventional wellhead systems and maximize the benefits of pad drilling.

P1.9.text: Cactus Wellhead™ has the quality products and the experienced service technicians to assure that your frac job will be completed without surprises.

P1.11.text: Cactus Wellhead™ products and systems are designed and manufactured to the highest industry standards. We have implemented a fully documented API Spec 6A and Q1/ISO 9001:2015 quality management system that supports our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities. Hands-on involvement and communication by branch operations, installation crews and manufacturing facilities ensure that Cactus Wellhead™ is fully committed to quality excellence and reduction of risk.

P1.13.text: Cactus Wellhead™, through a formal and comprehensive company-wide HSE management program, fulfills its commitment for the well-being and protection of individuals at all field and company locations. We establish and adhere to our own strict safety standards as well as those of our valued customers.

P2.2.text: Strength. We value their commitment to deliver quality and service excellence in support of our customers. With a robust and diverse inventory of tools, technology, and solutions, Drilling Tools International and its operating divisions are strongly positioned to support the oil, gas, and geothermal industries. Our facilities are strategically located across major global markets to ensure timely and efficient supply to our customers.

P2.3.text: Innovation. Drilling Tools International is committed to continuous improvement of our products and technology offerings, while also meeting the ever-changing needs of our customers. We drive innovation with the talent and passion of our dedicated employees. Our innovation team remains at the forefront of new ideas by actively developing, acquiring, and deploying cutting-edge technologies. By integrating the latest advancements into our processes and products, we enhance industry standards and deliver superior solutions that address even the most complex challenges across the well life cycle.

P2.4.text: Performance. We understand how crucial reliability is to our customers. That is why the world's foremost oil and gas operators and service companies trust Drilling Tools International to deliver reliable, competitive, and on-time solutions to address today's industry challenges.

P3.3.text: From a single weld to a full-on rig inspection, Downhole Inspection Solutions is the team to handle your specific needs. With one Canadian and four U.S. strategically located inspection facilities staffed by experienced and certified ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level II inspectors, DIS covers a wide range of inspection services. Our certified inspectors are equipped with advanced and calibrated non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. We are able to provide analysis, maintenance, and repair services to Bottom Hole Assembly (BHA) components and rig equipment to ensure that industry standards and customer specifications (TH Hill DS-1, API RP7G-2, etc.) are met or exceeded.

P3.4.text: Our Customer Order Management Portal and Support System (COMPASS) is a web-based repository for all things Inspection. Once registered, customers have access to their inspection records 24/7. They can also verify the status of upcoming orders and review previous orders.

P3.5.text: Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI) is a non-destructive testing process used to detect surface and shallow subsurface discontinuities in ferromagnetic materials. These materials include iron, nickel, cobalt, and some of their alloys. During MPI, a magnetic field is applied to the part, and ferrous particles (either dry or in a wet suspension) are used to identify areas of flux leakage. These areas form indications which are evaluated to determine their nature and cause. It is commonly used to identify defects like cracks, pores, cold laps, and lack of sidewall fusion in welds.
